disclosures.reason: want-zero AllocsPerRun assert: Decode returns a []rune that the managed runtime heap-allocates where Go's escape analysis stack-allocates the non-escaping result (the test is guarded by testenv.SkipIfOptimizationOff precisely because the zero-alloc outcome depends on the optimizer); a malloc-counting shim would fail identically. TestDecode proves the decoded output is correct — only the allocation profile diverges. RELABEL 2026-09-23 (C1, as ruled at ledger 2026-09-23 03:37 O5): alloc-profile -> deferred. Legs 2-4's unit is unrecorded because the host notes only a test's first nonzero call; each mints Decode's counted make on every run, so they are COUNT by construction.
